recipe.visualDefinition: A surrealist airbrushed scene featuring two classical figures in a dreamlike landscape. One figure lies horizontally while another leans over them, set against a backdrop of a massive Doric column, a large urn, and a canopy of golden-yellow foliage. The background depicts stylized, jagged mountains under a pale blue sky, all rendered with smooth gradients and a soft, ethereal glow.
coreVisualRelationships: The vertical column anchors the left side, balancing the large urn on the right.
The golden foliage at the top creates a natural frame for the central figures.
The figures' metallic, airbrushed skin tones reflect the blue and gold of the environment.
The horizontal orientation of the lower figure contrasts with the verticality of the column and standing figure.
coreInvariants: High-contrast lighting with golden highlights and blue shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two central figures occupy the lower-middle foreground, scaled to appear small against the monumental column.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A thick, vertical Doric column on the left side of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the golden foliage at the top, down the column, across the reclining figure, and up to the standing figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Open pale blue sky in the upper right quadrant provides breathing room for the dense foliage above.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pale sky blue and deep cerulean provide the cool base for shadows and sky.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Golden yellow and amber define the foliage, highlights, and ground plane.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White highlights create a metallic, reflective sheen on the figures and column.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright yellow leaves and the soft blue sky; saturation is moderate to create a dreamlike haze.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid harsh blacks; use deep blues for shadows

letterConstructionRules: Top line: Wide-tracked, all-caps sans-serif with thin strokes.
Bottom line: Cursive-influenced script with elongated descenders and ascenders, featuring a 'T' and 'P' that extend vertically.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'T' in the second line has a crossbar that extends over the entire word.
The 'P' has a long, sweeping descender.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A rigid, wide-spaced sans-serif paired with a fluid, organic script for contrast between order and nature.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rule created by the 'T' crossbar

preserve: Wide tracking of the top line
The specific green-to-white gradient in the script
avoid: Modern geometric sans-serifs with no tracking

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the wide, thin, classical feel of the top line.
Provides the organic, flowing contrast for the title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: An airbrushed surrealist painting of a classical scene. A large Doric column on the left, a large urn on the right. In the center, two figures in classical robes, one lying down and one leaning over. The background features jagged blue and gold mountains. The top is framed by dense, golden-yellow autumn leaves. Soft, ethereal lighting with blue shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of text at the top center. The first line is a wide-tracked, thin, white all-caps sans-serif. The second line is a larger, hand-drawn script in white with a green outline, featuring a very long horizontal crossbar on the initial 'T'.

verificationChecks: Is the column positioned on the left?
Does the foliage have a distinct golden-yellow hue?
Is the lighting rendered with smooth airbrush-style gradients?
Is the script text larger than the top line of text?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue/gold color contrast
Scale of the column relative to the figures
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the figures
Exact placement of every leaf in the canopy
The specific logo-like arrangement of the script lettering

mustAchieve: A sense of classical stillness and dreamlike atmosphere
Balanced composition between vertical and horizontal elements

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the figures have a metallic or marble-like sheen.
Check that the mountain range looks stylized rather than realistic.
Verify the text tracking is wide for the top line.
Confirm the presence of the large urn on the right side.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine classical Greek architectural motifs with 1980s airbrush surrealism, using a split-complementary palette of cerulean blue and amber gold, topped with high-contrast, wide-tracked typography.
